messages:
Anna (People Ops): Heads up — the interviewer shadowing checklist isn't showing up on candidate pages in the ATS for some roles. Noticed this morning while prepping the cohort.
Devin (Recruiter): Saw that too. Looks like attachments for the 'shadowing-checklist' are missing for roles created after last week's schema tweak. @Sam any context?
Sam (Hiring Ops): Yep. The schema change added a new 'prep_guides' field. Our ats-sync job currently ignores unknown fields and drops associated attachments unless metadata is present. I opened GH issue #3125.
Kara (Eng): Quick clarifying q: is it failing for PDFs/doc uploads or just embedded video links? I checked one candidate — the doc was gone but the doc preview sometimes appears.
Devin (Recruiter): Mostly the embedded videos and the PDFs branded as 'shadowing-checklist' — calendar invites also lack the prep link, so interviewers don't get the material automatically.
Anna (People Ops): This blocks tomorrow's shadow sessions for two panels. Can we get a temporary workaround? Manual uploads to interviewer notes maybe?
Sam (Hiring Ops): Workaround: manually upload the checklist to the candidate 'private notes' field — it surfaces to interviewers. It's annoying but quick. If you confirm an affected candidate list I can backfill for those.
CalendarBot: Reminder: Shadow session tomorrow 9:30am ET — attendees: @Devin, @Kara
Kara (Eng): If Mike can enable a fallback in ats-sync to treat unknown 'prep_guides' as attachments, we can hotfix it. @Mike?
Mike (Infra): I can push a small fallback: if unknown field contains a URL or blob, surface it as an attachment. Needs a staging deploy + quick canary. ETA ~3 hours once Sam gives the go.
Sam (Hiring Ops): I have a minimal patch ready to accept unknown 'prep_guides' as attachments. Plan: deploy to staging, canary on one role, then prod roll.
Devin (Recruiter): Please prioritize. Anna — do we want to notify candidates if we manually upload checklists? Could confuse them.
Anna (People Ops): No need to notify candidates. Just make sure interviewers get the prep. Also please post a short runbook for anyone who needs to attach manually.
Sam (Hiring Ops): Will post a one-pager in #recruiting-ops with steps to attach files and how to verify. I'll also backfill attachments for the last 7 days of roles after prod deploy.
Kara (Eng): If the hotfix is risky, canary on a single role (Product Intern) and monitor logs + calendar events.
Sam (Hiring Ops): Agreed — canary on Product Intern. I'll update this thread once staging deploy completes.
Devin (Recruiter): Assign me the backfill candidate list and I'll cross-check RSVPs and shadower assignments.
Anna (People Ops): Affected candidate IDs for immediate backfill: C-1023, C-1105, C-1110, C-1122, C-1157, C-1168, C-1172, C-1189.
Sam (Hiring Ops): Staging deploy finished, canary passed. Rolling to prod now; will backfill immediately after.
Sam (Hiring Ops): Prod deploy finished. Backfill in progress.
Sam (Hiring Ops): Backfill complete. Calendar invites now show the prep link for the affected candidates. Please check and shout if anything still missing.
Devin (Recruiter): Confirmed — looks good for my panels. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
Anna (People Ops): Huge thanks. Sam — drop the runbook link here when ready and I'll close the incident from my side.
